sentences.sentence: I have always wanted to go on a safari.
I would love to go to South Africa for a safari adventure.
I want to go to Hawaii because I want to try surfing.
I want to take photos of all the amazing animals.
I would have my brother join me on my trip.
It would be so exciting to see these animals in the wild.
Without a doubt, I would love to go to Egypt and see the pyramids.
What kind of adventure would you like to have?
